e030adce-d3d6-4638-b92a-11f6ff7fb67f@ufc.why: In the main event, two ranked lightweights, Moicano (#12) and Nolan (#14), fight for position just below champion Islam Makhachev. Moicano, a former title challenger, is trying to stay relevant in a stacked division, while Nolan, unbeaten since his UFC debut loss and riding a five-fight win streak, gets his first main event and first five-round test. In the co-feature, ranked bantamweights Yana Santos and Luana Santos meet, with the winner moving closer to a shot at champion Kayla Harrison.
e030adce-d3d6-4638-b92a-11f6ff7fb67f@ufc.know: UFC rankings run champion then #1 to #15 per weight class; a Fight Night card has no belt at stake, but strong wins still move fighters up those rankings toward a title shot. Yana Santos last appeared on the Sept 26 card against Raoni Barcelos, so viewers may recognize her coming in on a win streak.
